population: Five whole English MIT OCW lectures, two serial trials each, same audio/video packets; separate official reference captions
normalization: Decode HTML entities, Unicode NFKC, casefold
For references parse WebVTT cues and join text in cue order; remove markup and non-speech square-bracket annotations from both texts
Remove uppercase speaker-name prefixes followed by colon; keep their spoken words
Remove digit-grouping commas only between digits; convert standalone nonnegative integers and decimal strings using num2words 0.5.14 English cardinal spelling in both texts
Keep Unicode letter/number codepoints only, removing all punctuation and whitespace; no spelling correction or domain-specific substitutions
cer: Levenshtein character edit distance / normalized reference codepoint count; weighted aggregate=sum(distances)/sum(reference_lengths), not mean of per-lecture percentages
variation: Two repeats: arithmetic mean, sample standard deviation (ddof=1), minimum and maximum; no confidence or population claims
processing_e2e: Monotonic elapsed time immediately before POST /api/tasks through observed index READY; includes queueing/polling; excludes upload/download and offline subtitle-track removal
stages: Existing pipeline_step_completed log durationMillis; actual index HTTP requests separately measured, index wait is task terminal-to-observed READY and includes poll/scheduler delay
cost: Actual ASR input/output tokens from transparent proxy times official China Beijing list prices 0.8/2.7 CNY per million; local translation/embedding have zero external API fees, machine cost unavailable; missing usage or failed calls are never silently priced at zero
budget: Stop before the next ASR request when accounted spend plus in-flight headroom would exceed the evaluation guard; no proxy retries or caching; successful missing usage stops future requests
reference_status: Official OCW professional captions. MIT News documents ASR draft plus human editing/manager review, but individual captioner logs for these five files are not available; not an independently reannotated human gold standard.
